cells.name: Feedstock silo
cells.description: A powder feedstock silo seen from above: its ribbed conical roof, a fill hatch at the apex, a walkway round the rim.

cells.name: Split feedstock silo
cells.description: The silo split open down its east side, pale feedstock powder spilled out to its east edge.

cells.name: Reactor column
cells.description: A catalytic reactor column's top head on its square grated platform, a ring of flange bolts round a central nozzle.

cells.name: Product tank
cells.description: A round product tank on a square grated platform.

cells.name: Lattice tank
cells.description: A square cryogenic lattice tank, frost on its window.

cells.name: Coating chamber
cells.description: A square vacuum coating chamber, its round sealed door on top, the hinge block east.

cells.name: Nutrient tank
cells.description: A round nutrient tank: domed roof, manway, a culture sample port, nozzles west.

cells.name: Feed tank
cells.description: A round feed tank: domed roof, manway, nozzles west.

cells.name: Precursor tank
cells.description: A round precursor tank, heater bands on its roof, chemical crust.

cells.name: Draw tower
cells.description: The head of a fibre draw tower: a square frame on four legs round its furnace bore, a dull glow at the bottom.

cells.name: Chiller
cells.description: A big industrial chiller: three fan shrouds across its roof, its condenser coil bank along the south side.

cells.name: Burst chiller
cells.description: The chiller burst open at its south-east corner, frozen coolant spilled over it as an ice sheet.

cells.name: Preheat furnace
cells.description: A feed preheat furnace: a firebox with four burner ports, its flue stack north-east.

cells.name: Cold manifold
cells.description: A cold distribution manifold: a header block with four frosted couplings, insulated pipes leaving north and south.

cells.name: Cryostat
cells.description: A cryostat lying east-west on its end frames, frosted.

cells.name: Feed pumps
cells.description: Two nutrient feed pumps on a shared skid.

cells.name: Ice ridge
cells.description: A ridge of coolant frozen where it poured from a burst header.

cells.name: Hoist winder
cells.description: A shaft hoist winder: a grooved drum between two pedestals, its two cables leaving the north edge toward the shaft.

cells.name: Spool winder
cells.description: A fibre spool winder: a machine bed round a bare turntable (the spool drum is laid over it), its traverse guide east.

cells.name: Beam dump
cells.description: A particle beam dump: a shielded block, the beam pipe entering its core from the north edge.

cells.name: Ring segment
cells.description: A storage ring dipole segment, its beam pipe north-south through it, flush to both edges: a straight run of the ring.

cells.name: Ring segment (east-west)
cells.description: The ring segment turned east-west.

cells.name: RF cavity
cells.description: An RF accelerating cavity: two copper-cored cells on the beam pipe north-south, its waveguide stub east.

cells.name: Linac section
cells.description: A linac cryomodule on the beam pipe, north-south.

cells.name: Cutter rack
cells.description: A rack of spare bore cutter discs, four shelves.

cells.name: Drum rack
cells.description: A rack of full fibre spool drums, four shelves.
